## Checklist

- [ ] `tox` passes locally (lint, and the tests on both backends).
- [ ] Tests added or updated. A bug fix has a test that failed before the fix.
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in `docs/` and under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] No test was weakened, the coverage floor was not lowered, and no validation was removed.
- [ ] I have read and understood every line of this change and can explain it.
